mapper.select: SELECT s.sb_djid, s.sbdm, s.sbmc, s.sbbm, CASE WHEN k.sb_djid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as assigned FROM sys_sbdjb s LEFT JOIN bgxt_ksyqsz k ON s.sb_djid = k.sb_djid AND k.ksdm = #{ksdm} WHERE s.tybz = 0 ORDER BY s.sb_djid
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO bgxt_ksyqsz (ksdm, sb_djid) VALUES (#{ksdm}, #{sbDjid})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bgxt_ksyqsz WHERE ksdm = #{ksdm} AND sb_djid = #{sbDjid}
